name: Camera Orientation Setup with Gimbal Lock Prevention
aliases: Spherical Camera Orientation with Up-Vector Flip
definition: Computes camera position, look-at target, and up-vector from spherical coordinates, handling the up-vector flip when the camera points downwards or backwards to avoid gimbal lock or inverted views.
summary: This method computes camera orientation from spherical coordinates, explicitly flipping the up-vector to prevent gimbal lock and inverted views when pointing downwards or backwards.
